title: SB168 (134th Legislature (2021-2022)): Establish Ohio Mobile Training Team Program

other_topics: education-school-police: Section 1 (new R.C. 5502.70, 5502.702; R.C. 5502.01, 5502.262) — creates the Ohio mobile training team and school safety training/planning duties beyond guns

operative_text:
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.122): (D)(1) This section does not apply to any of the following: ... provided the officer satisfies the criteria set forth in divisions (C)(1) or (2) and (D) of section 5502.701 of the Revised Code, or any other person who has written authorization from the board of education or governing body of a school to convey deadly weapons or dangerous ordnance into a school safety zone or to possess a deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance in a school safety zone and who conveys or possesses the deadly weapon or dangerous ordnance in accordance with that authorization provided the person satisfies the criteria set forth in divisions (C)(1) or (2) and (D) of section 5502.701 of the Revised Code;
Section 1 (new R.C. 5502.701): (C) No person is eligible for appointment to the position of school safety designee unless one of the following applies: (1) The person is a school resource officer; (2) The person is in a category described in division (A)(2)(b) or (c) of this section and has successfully completed a basic firearms training program for school safety designees, as described in division (A)(18) of section 109.73 and division (B) of section 109.743 of the Revised Code.
Section 1 (new R.C. 5502.701): (2) No person who has been appointed to serve as a school safety designee may carry a concealed weapon while serving in that capacity unless the person has a valid concealed handgun license.
Section 1 (new R.C. 5502.701): (D)(1) No person who has been appointed to serve as the chief mobile training officer, as a regional mobile training officer, or as a school safety designee may continue to serve in that capacity unless the person, within the preceding quarterly period, has successfully completed the firearms requalification training program for the position as specified in division (A)(2) of section 109.801 of the Revised Code.
